dz: 意大利的路易二世在罗马第二次被加冕为神圣罗马皇帝,享年47岁. 他第一次加冕是在前28年,844年他父亲洛泰一世统治期间.
de: Louis II of Italy is crowned for the second time as Holy Roman Emperor at Rome, at the age of 47. His first coronation was 28 years earlier, in 844, during the reign of his father Lothair I.
